description_en: Lists all databases in a specified cluster

kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-adb-mysql-schemas --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou

If the request was successful, Success is returned.
